tasks.oracle: POINT plus CIRCLE both inside the X button rect

tasks.say: Draw a house.
tasks.oracle: Vision judge: house (body + roof, door optional); roof sits on the body (endpoints within 15 px)

tasks.say: Draw a heart.
tasks.oracle: Vision judge: heart; symmetric within 15% of its width

tasks.say: Draw a sun in the top right corner.
tasks.oracle: Circle plus >= 6 ray PATHs; whole sun inside the top-right quarter

tasks.say: Draw a big arrow pointing down.
tasks.oracle: ARROW with y2 > y1 and length >= 30% of screen height

tasks.say: Draw a tree.
tasks.oracle: Vision judge: tree (trunk + crown)

tasks.say: Draw a cat.
tasks.oracle: Vision judge: cat-like (head, ears, whiskers). Accept a simple face. Marks <= 12
